attchmntText: Prime Focus Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Prime Focus Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board reviewed the results as recommended by the Audit Committee. Statutory Auditors M S K A & Associates LLP issued a Limited Review Report with an unmodified conclusion. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net loss of 9,681.12 lakh rupees, compared to a net loss of 719.17 lakh rupees in the same period of 2025. Revenue from operations was 1,540.24 lakh rupees. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 1,239.46 lakh rupees as of September 30, 2026. The company also noted the allotment of equity shares pursuant to the exercise of stock options by employees.

attchmntText: Prime Focus Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Prime Focus Limited has intimated the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the schedule of an Institutional Investor Meeting. Representatives of the company will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX 2026 Annual Investor Conference on November 16, 2026. The event will be held at the Grand Hyatt in Mumbai. The meeting format includes group and one-on-one sessions. The company confirmed that no unpublished price-sensitive information will be shared or discussed during the meeting or calls. The schedule is subject to changes due to exigencies on the part of investors or the company. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued by Parina Shah, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 7, 2026.

attchmntText: Prime Focus Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 07, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Prime Focus Limited announced the voting results of its Extra-Ordinary General Meeting held on November 07, 2026. The company confirmed that all resolutions were passed with the requisite majority. The first resolution, requiring a special majority, concerned the cessation of control over Brahma AI Holdings Limited and its subsidiary Brahma AI Services India Limited. This resolution received one hundred percent support from the promoter group and ninety-nine point two eight percent of total votes polled. The remaining three resolutions were ordinary matters regarding material related party transactions involving DNEG S.à.r.l., Double Negative Holdings Limited, and Brahma AI Holdings Limited. These transactions included platform license arrangements. The promoters abstained from voting on these related party matters. Public shareholders approved these transactions with significant majorities. The consolidated scrutinizer’s report is available on the company website and CDSL portal.

attchmntText: Prime Focus Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 07, 2026
voiceSummary: Prime Focus Limited announced the outcome of its Extra-Ordinary General Meeting held on November 07, 2026. The meeting was conducted via video conference from 12:30 p.m. to 01:01 p.m. The company confirmed that all resolutions placed before the members were passed with the requisite majority. The resolutions included the cessation of control over Brahma AI Holdings Limited and Brahma AI Services India Limited, approved as a special resolution. Additionally, ordinary resolutions were passed for material related party transactions involving DNEG S.à.r.l., Double Negative Holdings Limited, and Brahma AI Holdings Limited. Mr. Harshvardhan Tarkas served as the scrutinizer for the voting process. The consolidated scrutinizer report and e-voting results are to be submitted within the stipulated time and declared on the company website and stock exchanges.
